In the related litigation MAT-042, the case remains active with discovery progressing. The opposing party has submitted a settlement offer which proposes a reduced damages figure and includes a confidentiality clause. Our assessment indicates the presiding judge has a moderate historical tendency to grant summary judgment in similar commercial disputes, though the current factual record appears insufficient for a favorable ruling at this stage, supporting our strategy to proceed to mediation. Notably, opposing counsel has demonstrated a willingness to negotiate on damages during recent communications, suggesting a potential path to resolution. We recommend continuing preparation for mediation while using the settlement offer as a benchmark for negotiations.
